purpose: Resolve whether one bounded real evidence package can be made available under the existing E01–E03 contracts; no new collection or operational intervention is authorized.

selection.rule: First establish an accepted accountable owner, lawful access and a complete decision-relevant record slice; then choose the case whose usable linked records can resolve a material uncertainty with approved burden and safeguards. Budget size, public-document volume and the existence of this package are not access evidence.
selection.substitution_rule: Retain all three F01 initial targets. Any replacement requires prospectively recorded scope rationale; no case is dropped because its result may be adverse or null.

current_access_facts.interpretation: Counts reflect the retained request-status register, not claims about records held elsewhere in the UN.

common_decisions_before_dispatch: Confirm a competent accountable owner and records custodian; proposed roles do not establish acceptance.
Confirm the decision question, institutional purpose, applicable authority, records classification, permitted analyst access and approved restricted storage.
Agree the smallest complete eligible population, observation dates, extraction definition, exclusions, correction/settlement lag and control totals before inspecting outcomes.
Confirm field availability and extraction burden; revise scope or leave blocked when burden or completeness is unacceptable.
Set custodian retention/deletion and re-identification rules; keep raw records, pseudonymous tokens, mapping tables and sensitive operating details outside public Git.
Separate an observational record-availability/reconciliation review from any later live process intervention. The latter requires its own authority and prospective operational safeguards.
sampling_boundary: The proposed slices are bounded feasibility and mechanism-tracing exercises, not statistically powered portfolio samples. No numerical sample size, period or impact threshold is invented. A complete slice can support only its declared case/entity/service/period decision; expansion requires a new prospective scope.

cases.decision_question: Can one client's charge for one agreed RSCE service line be reconciled to the provider credit and an approved allocation denominator, while showing what decision/control work remains locally?

proposed_smallest_slice.selection: One jointly selected client, one service category and one closed comparable accounting period; obtain the entire eligible slice and its linked corrections/settlements, not only apparently duplicated or successfully matched lines.
proposed_smallest_slice.minimum_scope_control: Retain the approved full allocation denominator/control total needed to test this client's share without collecting unrelated clients' identifiable transactions.
proposed_smallest_slice.no_generalization: A single-client reconciliation cannot establish RSCE-wide staffing efficiency, overbilling or post savings.

public_inputs: Dated service responsibilities and client scope
Published budget/accounting perimeters and documented organizational proposals
Public mandate/financial authority anchors, subject to verification
required_evidence_receipts: Approved allocation schedule and denominator with entity/service/period scope
Client and provider extraction definitions, counts and signed control totals; all corrections and unmatched lines
Custodian explanation of retained delegated decisions, approvals and segregation-of-duties controls
Dated workload/SLA definition and coverage statement, including unavailable or failed services
proposed_custodian_roles: RSCE controller or authorized finance custodian
Client mission finance and service-line accountable managers
acceptance_questions: Which client/service/closed period has both sides of the journal and the approved allocation denominator available?
Which retained local tasks are required client decisions or controls, and which are actually substitutable processing?
Can all eligible lines, reversals and late settlements be supplied with independent control totals without excessive burden?
cases.next_decision_if_complete: Authorize a bounded observational reconciliation and decide whether any unmatched cost/work mechanism merits fuller operational validation; do not call the charge or unmatched amount waste.
cases.stop_or_defer: Keep blocked if the counterpart ledger, allocation denominator, required local-control explanation or service-outcome coverage is missing.

cases.decision_question: Can a documented UNSCOL requirement be traced through a UNIFIL asset's condition, handover, service acceptance and actual costs, with a genuine otherwise-needed acquisition counterfactual?

proposed_smallest_slice.selection: One agreed asset class and one pre-existing recipient requirement or complete small requirement cohort, fixed before outcomes are examined. Include assets proposed but not transferred, rejected or unavailable, as well as completed handovers.
proposed_smallest_slice.minimum_scope_control: Supply the eligible requirement/asset population and exclusions so a successful transfer is not cherry-picked; link each selected asset to its requirement and custody history.
proposed_smallest_slice.no_generalization: One traceable requirement/asset chain cannot establish all transition savings or the performance of every transfer.

public_inputs: Dated UNIFIL/UNSCOL mandate and transition context
Published proposed asset-reuse and recipient-budget statements
required_evidence_receipts: Pre-existing need and procurement plan/commitment/cancellation chronology; distinguish a hypothetical purchase from an actual avoidable commitment
Custody, serviceable-condition and recipient acceptance receipts
Transport/preparation, retained maintenance/storage, disposal and residual liability costs, with source population completeness
Readiness and service-continuity definition plus custodian explanation of remaining UNIFIL obligations
proposed_custodian_roles: UNIFIL property, finance and transition custodians
UNSCOL property, procurement, finance and receiving-service custodians
acceptance_questions: Is there a complete requirement-to-asset chain for an agreed asset class, including non-transfers and rejections?
Was the recipient's otherwise-needed purchase feasible and cancellable, and what receipt establishes that counterfactual?
Which source and recipient transition/residual costs and availability obligations remain after handover?
cases.next_decision_if_complete: Assess whether one bounded transfer mechanism can be operationally and financially tested after complete net-cost and readiness evidence; keep already embedded measures in the baseline.
cases.stop_or_defer: Keep blocked if requirement chronology, signed acceptance, serviceability, feasible procurement alternative or material residual costs are unavailable.

cases.decision_question: Can one BINUH support service be traced across UNSOH billing, client and provider records, supplier cost and delivered units while preserving support availability and accounting boundaries?

proposed_smallest_slice.selection: One jointly selected service type and one closed billing period, with the complete client/provider/supplier line population and linked reversals/settlements. Select comparable periods prospectively only after the handover/service chronology and accrual/settlement lag are known.
proposed_smallest_slice.minimum_scope_control: Identify whether aviation is contained in a broader support package; keep included components and internal transfers separate, with a complete source cost/control-total receipt.
proposed_smallest_slice.no_generalization: A billing-period trace cannot establish system-wide aviation utilization or recurring savings; precise flight routes, schedules and security details are unnecessary for public derivatives.

public_inputs: Competent mandate and dated support-transition/service responsibility statements
Published aviation and broader support proposal amounts with nonadditivity boundaries
Public administrative/financial authority anchors subject to action-specific applicability review
required_evidence_receipts: BINUH and UNSOH extraction definitions, counts/control totals, corrections and unmatched items
Supplier expense/contract scope receipt and distinction between internal reimbursement and external cost
Delivered-unit/availability completeness receipt without sensitive operating routes or narrative detail
Scope bridge showing aviation versus broader support inclusions, retained local work and transition costs
proposed_custodian_roles: BINUH support and finance accountable custodians
UNSOH support and finance accountable custodians
acceptance_questions: Which service and closed period have both client/provider postings and supplier cost/delivery records available?
Are aviation amounts a subset of a larger support charge, and can the included population be identified?
Can availability, quality and retained local cost be assessed without exposing sensitive operating details?
cases.next_decision_if_complete: Reconcile internal allocations and external costs, then decide whether an operational alternative can be tested with prospective service safeguards.
cases.stop_or_defer: Keep blocked if either ledger side, external cost/delivery linkage, support-package scope or security-safe outcome evidence is missing.

delivery_receipt_for_each_authorized_sli.public_derivative: Only independently disclosure-reviewed aggregates and opaque receipts; no transaction/asset tokens or private storage locations in public Git.

burden.rule: Do not promise a zero-burden export or set a staff-hour estimate without custodian evidence.

limitations: This access package narrows existing request contracts; it is not an accepted institutional request or approval.
No actual evidence package, owner acceptance or record accessibility has been established.
Public-source refreshes maintained in sibling priority-case files do not prove internal records are accessible.
Numerical operating thresholds and observation windows remain unset until actual baselines and applicable standards can support prospective owner-approved specifications.
maturity_access_distinction: F03 VALIDATION_READY is research-design maturity and requires proposed owner role and evidence custodian, not accepted institutional ownership. Access/collection authorization is a separate gate; accepted accountable ownership is explicitly required at IMPLEMENTATION_READY. This package does not promote or adjudicate any candidate state.

f03_validation_ready_review.assessment_rule: PRESENT_AS_DESIGN means a relevant design artifact exists, not that a substantive reviewer has approved every condition. No mandatory check is set literally true by this package; a transition requires reviewed event checks and receipts under F03.

checks.gap: Define the precise client/service or asset requirement cohort, affected outputs and observation boundary. Proposed minimal slice still has unset identifiers and dates; do not pick after seeing favorable outcomes.
checks.next_action: Record a prospectively bounded research slice and exclusions with a feasible comparison design. Acceptance of an operational owner is not itself the F03 design requirement.

Preserve proposed role/custodian specificity. Confirm actual custodian and access separately before dispatch/collection; do not falsely require accepted institutional ownership to document research readiness.

checks.gap: Cost perimeter and nonadditivity cautions exist. Verified mandate/competence and specific service/asset-change applicability must be attached to the exact bounded research unit; proposed budget or general mission mandate is insufficient by itself.
checks.next_action: Attach fresh priority-case public evidence receipts and distinguish mission mandate, budget authority and authority for a particular operational change.
Use the existing purpose-bound contract; dispatch, access and records receipt are separate facts and remain unavailable. Do not make dispatch a prerequisite merely for research-design readiness.

checks.gap: A defined design exists; its exact frame must be frozen with the selected bounded unit. Feasibility and actual comparable observations remain later evidentiary questions.
checks.next_action: Specify same-scope comparison and reasons to retain the current process; do not require actual achieved outcomes at VALIDATION_READY.

checks.gap: Service/safety/readiness dimensions, metrics and stop/fallback principles exist; numerical baselines/thresholds and observation windows remain unset. A reviewer must determine the guardrail design required for this exact research unit; metric labels alone are not an approved check, while absence of an accepted owner or measured outcomes is not automatically a F03 failure.
checks.next_action: Document baseline-measurement and threshold-setting sequence before outcome review, applicable standards and non-negotiable stop conditions; obtain operational approvals separately before live change.
Retain the registered CASE/C namespace mapping and all pool memberships; no benefit allocation or total is recognized.

cases.conclusion: Design prerequisites are partly present; remaining research-design/applicability judgments require specific receipts. This package neither approves nor rejects a VALIDATION_READY transition, and missing internal evidence or accepted ownership is not used as a substitute for the seven-check review.
